name: Doratia
source:
The Dragon Princess, leader of the Monster tribe. She had been in a long slumber but recently awoke. Arrogant and temperamental, self-centered yet surprisingly simple-minded.

Easily swayed and quick to go along with things, she has a bright, straightforward, and refreshing personality.

Since other monsters handle her daily care, she is naive and lacks common sense in crucial areas.
Regarding romance, she's never had a partner and thus remains indifferent.

[From the [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid/charactor02.html]Official website[/url]]
